content:
morgan: Quick heads-up — Greenfield private rollout is blocked, need owners for a couple of things. Image sync to their offline registry failing with signature errors. Anyone who owns the signing key flow?

ravi: I saw the 403s in the sync logs earlier. error: signature verification failed for image x.z:sha256:...

jin: @ravi can you paste the sync command you used? also are they using our recommended timestamped tags or pinning to a digest?

ravi: Using our offline-sync tool: `./offline-sync --src=registry.redwood.io/greenfield --dst=file://mnt/airgap`
Logs show `manifest signature mismatch` and then `403`. They seemed to rekey last week.

alana: I own the signing key rotation docs but not the actual keys. Pinged infra-key-admins, but can we confirm whether Greenfield uploaded the new public key to their KMS?

morgan: Good call. Alana, can you check their tenant config? They might have the old pubkey in their bootstrap. Also need someone to own network fallback: their egress VPN to our staging region drops intermittently during big pushes.

sam: I can take egress fallback owner. Plan is to switch sync to the alternate peering while we validate the registry keys. Need approval to route ~500GB over the alternate link — is that ok?

ops-bot: change-request #GREEN-112 created by sam for routing ~500GB via alternate-peering. Waiting for approvals from netops and security.

jin: Also flag: our canary script expects NTP-synced nodes. Greenfield's airgapped hosts show ~7s drift which breaks signature validation on the manifest timestamps. Who owns NTP for private rollouts?

alana: That's under infra-timeowners, but I can coordinate. Quick remediation is to run `chronyd -q` after network up and resync. For long term we should add an NTP preflight check in the onboarding playbook.

ravi: Ok, I'll re-run the sync after we confirm keys + ntp fix. One more: PR #4321 (orchestration change for retry backoff) is still awaiting review — that will reduce transient 403s from aggressive retries. Can someone from eng-runtime take a look?

morgan: @jin can you pick up PR #4321 review? If merged it would help but not unblock the key issue. Also please add a quick test in the sync harness that fails the rollout if manifest timestamp differs by >2s.

jin: On it. Will do a quick review today and add the test.

deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run canary for Greenfield set for 2024-11-12T02:00Z, will abort if prereqs not met.

morgan: Summary / next steps: 1) Alana to confirm Greenfield uploaded new public key and update tenant bootstrap (owner: alana). 2) Sam to own egress fallback routing CR and monitor cost + approvals (owner: sam). 3) Ravi to re-run sync after key+ntp fixes (owner: ravi). 4) Jin to review PR #4321 and add NTP manifest-timestamp test (owner: jin). 5) I'll hold the canary start until deploy-bot shows prereqs green. Ping here when each step is done.

sam: Acknowledged — I'll update CR and tag netops/security. ETA for approvals ~3-4 hours.

alana: Confirmed I can see a mismatched pubkey in their tenant config. Asking Greenfield to resubmit their public key now.

ravi: Will stand by. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

morgan: If approvals or key resubmit stalls beyond EOD, we'll fall back to a manual image handoff and schedule a maintenance window.

jin: FYI I'm adding the NTP check to the onboarding checklist in the playbook PR. Will link here when done.

morgan: Great. Closing the loop — leave any adhoc notes below and I'll update the rollout tracker.
